educationalGoal: In this course, students will learn methods to transform society through specializ ed study of the SDGs. In addition, by developing SDG gamification materials, students will deepen their understanding of the SDGs, experience the process of developing their own products and making them better, and acquire the thinking necessary to explore ways of soc ial change in the process.
advice: Since 2016, activities have been taking place around the world to achieve the SDGs, which are common goals for a ll UN member states. In this class, students will learn an overview of the SDGs and how they can actually create their own actions an d involve others. In particular, the second half of the class will focus on the development and utilization of gamification materi als and social implementation, deepening students' understanding of how to create activities that improve societ y while having fun at the same time.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
